rank_math.description: Window screen installation and repair across the GTA. New screens, re-mesh, and custom frames cut to fit. Pet-resistant and retractable options. Same or next day.

fields.hero_h1: Window Screen Installation and Repair in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Torn, bent, or missing screens? We supply, repair, and install window screens cut to fit, across the GTA.
fields.overview_body:
A torn or missing screen lets bugs in and drags down the look of the whole window. SolidGuard does window screen installation across Toronto and the GTA: new screens measured and cut to fit, plus window screen repair when the frame is good and only the mesh has gone.

Choose standard mesh, pet-resistant mesh, or a retractable screen, in a frame colour to match your windows. Whether you need one window screen replacement or a whole home re-screened, we measure on site so every screen seats clean and tight.

faqs.question: Can you repair a screen, or do I need a new one?
faqs.answer: If the frame is straight we re-mesh it, which is the cheaper window screen repair. If the frame is bent, a new screen is the better value.

faqs.question: Do you make custom-size screens?
faqs.answer: Yes. We measure on site and cut every screen to fit your window exactly.

faqs.question: Do you offer pet-resistant mesh?
faqs.answer: Yes, along with retractable screens and standard mesh, in frame colours to match your windows.

faqs.question: How fast can you come out?
faqs.answer: Same or next day across most of the GTA.
